work.title: Hot Pink Tag, Snowman Trio
work.description: Layered spray-paint tags in magenta, teal, white, and black cover a dark-paneled metal surface, accumulating across multiple sessions of application. Partially legible letterforms overlap figurative elements including a blue rounded form with a white halo and a stacked three-circle motif at center-right.
work.composition: all-over graffiti field with central snowman trio
